name: Mahoshova!
source:
While working as a magical girl, the protagonist found herself at the age of 20. Every day she deals with a certain problem.

One day, a vampire wakes up from a 200-year sleep.
She is asked to go and see if this vampire will do anything bad.

And through this encounter with the vampire, the troubles that the protagonist was having took an unexpected turn...!

The protagonist is angry, the vampire is a carefree goofball, and her worried (elder) cousin also gets involved.

This is a short, light-hearted romantic comedy game.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210104027/http://sunset77light.rdy.jp/mahosyo/index.html]official website[/url]]
